abstain_when: Contrast orientation is unknown or conflicted.
assumptions: The linked result is the result intended by the report claim.

counterevidence_protocol.applies_when: The claim and result directions appear inconsistent.
counterevidence_protocol.description: Check for upstream contrast or reference reversal.
Check whether the surrounding report text qualifies or negates the extracted direction.

coverage_contract.covered_when: Claim, result, and orientation are all linked and supported.
coverage_contract.not_covered_when: Orientation or result linkage is unavailable.
coverage_contract.partially_covered_when: Result is linked but some non-material lineage metadata is absent.

description: Checks whether an explicitly reported direction agrees with the linked result under established orientation.
limitations: Does not determine whether a different analysis would reverse the result.
title: Claim/result direction agreement
wording_constraints: State only the bounded direction mismatch.
Do not claim the biological conclusion is false.
